affected.note: Worldwide total of CAPCOM ID records whose email address and system identifiers (account creation and last login times, login count, last login IP) leaked. 43 also included birthdate, gender, country/region and nickname; 196 accounts had passwords changed by the attacker. Capcom said user-set passwords and credit card data were not leaked.

summary.en: Capcom found traces of unauthorized access to its CAPCOM ID service on 2026-10-19. It announced that email addresses and system identifiers of 11,774,247 accounts worldwide leaked, and that passwords of 196 accounts were changed without authorization.
summary.ja: カプコンは2026年10月19日に「CAPCOM ID」への不正アクセスの痕跡を発見した。全世界で11,774,247件のメールアドレスとシステム固有の識別情報が漏えいし、196件のアカウントでログインパスワードが不正に変更されたと発表した。
